errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match an account here.
errors.passwordLoginDisabled: Password sign-in is turned off for this organization. Use single sign-on below.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.

unauthenticated.title: Sign in to see {{resource}}
unauthenticated.body: Your session is missing or has expired, so the control plane refused the request. This is not a problem with the data.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to {{resource}}
forbidden.body: You are signed in, but your role does not permit reading this. Retrying will not help — ask an administrator to widen your role.

openMode.title: {{resource}} needs an admin token
openMode.body: The control plane is running with no admin token, so it has no accounts and cannot serve per-user data to anyone. Signing in will not fix this: set ROLTER_ADMIN_TOKEN and restart it.

unreachable.title: Cannot reach the control plane
unreachable.body: The request for {{resource}} got no answer at all. Check that the control plane is running and that this dashboard points at the right address.

server.title: The control plane failed to return {{resource}}
server.body: It answered, and the answer was an error. Its own message is below; the server logs will have more.

unknown.title: Could not load {{resource}}
unknown.body: The control plane rejected the request for a reason the dashboard does not recognise. Its own message is below.

modelSheet.currencyUnconvertible: {{code}} has no conversion rate configured, so this price cannot be converted to {{base}} and will not reach spend or budgets. Add it to [currency.rates] in the bootstrap config, or price in {{base}}.

dashboard.notConfiguredBody: Traffic, spend, and latency appear here once requests flow through the gateway. Set clickhouse_url on the control plane to enable logging.
dashboard.noSpendRecorded: No spend recorded for this window. Requests were served, but none of them were priced — add pricing for the models in use to see cost here.

unpriced.title_one: {{count}} request in this window is unpriced.
unpriced.title_other: {{count}} requests in this window are unpriced.
unpriced.body_one: They ran against {{count}} model with no price set, so spend below is a floor, not a total. Set a price to include them.
unpriced.body_other: They ran against {{count}} models with no price set, so spend below is a floor, not a total. Set prices to include them.

unpriced.hint: This model has no price row, so its traffic is recorded as unpriced rather than free. Its spend is missing from totals and budgets until a price is set.

plugins.noOrg: Choose an organization to manage plugins.

plugins.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? The gateway stops consulting it immediately.

plugins.hintSecret: Store the variable name, never the secret value.
plugins.hintConfig: A JSON object sent to the plugin on every dispatch.
plugins.enabledHint: An enabled plugin is consulted on live traffic at its stage. Paused plugins keep their configuration but are skipped.
plugins.errorConfigObject: Configuration must be a JSON object.
plugins.errorNameEndpoint: Name and an HTTP(S) endpoint are required.

strategyHints.needsTelemetry: Needs a cache-telemetry source (KV events or an LMCache controller) configured on the target providers. Without one it quietly falls back to least-load.
strategyHints.deploymentWide: Controlled by the deployment-wide adaptive-routing policy, not from here. Kept so this route is not changed by saving.

pricing.unconvertible: Priced in {{code}}, which has no conversion rate — this model's spend is missing from {{base}} totals and budgets.

playground.modelsNeedKey: Showing configured routes. Set a virtual key above to list what the gateway actually serves — provider-pinned and provider-group addresses only appear in the gateway's list.
playground.modelsUnreachable: Could not read the gateway's model list with this key, so configured routes are shown instead. Provider-pinned and provider-group addresses are missing from this list.

promptRepo.renameDescription: The slug {{slug}} is the stable identity and never changes. Versions and scopes are untouched.
promptRepo.deleteLive: v{{version}} is live — anything routing through this template starts failing immediately.
promptRepo.deleteUnpublished: This template has never been published.
promptRepo.deleteConsequence: Every version, scope and sample is deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
promptRepo.created: Template created. Add its first immutable draft.
promptRepo.draftSaved: Draft v{{version}} saved. Its content and scopes are now immutable.
promptRepo.draftSavedScopeError: Draft v{{version}} was saved, but its scopes were not: {{error}}
promptRepo.rolledBack: Rolled back: v{{version}} is live again.
promptRepo.problemInvalidName: “{{name}}” is not a valid variable name.
promptRepo.problemRequiredDefault: Required variable “{{name}}” cannot also have a default.
promptRepo.emptyDescription: Create a named template, then add variables, ordered decorators, and its first deployment scope.
promptRepo.variablesDescription: Declare placeholders used as {{sample}} inside decorators.
promptRepo.noVariables: No variables. This template renders the same content for every request.
promptRepo.decoratorsDescription: Build ordered messages around the caller's original conversation.
promptRepo.scopesDescription: Choose where this exact version can be resolved. Empty means it is not assigned.
promptRepo.previewDescription: Sample values stay in your browser and are never saved.
promptRepo.missingSamples: Add sample values for {{names}} to complete the preview.
promptRepo.addDecoratorHint: Add a decorator to see the rendered prompt.
promptRepo.createDescription: The slug is a stable identity. Content is added as an immutable version next.
promptRepo.rollbackDescription: This changes the live version from v{{from}} to immutable v{{to}}. The newer versions remain in history.

skillsRepo.deletePublished: v{{version}} is published — agents resolving this skill start failing immediately.
skillsRepo.deleteUnpublished: This skill has never been published.
skillsRepo.deleteConsequence: Every version and access rule is deleted with it. Retire it instead if you only want it hidden.
skillsRepo.created: Skill created. Add its first immutable version.
skillsRepo.versionSaved: Version v{{version}} saved. Its content and metadata are now immutable.
skillsRepo.publishedNotice: v{{version}} is now the resolved version.
skillsRepo.retiredNotice: Skill retired. It no longer resolves for callers.
skillsRepo.metadataNotObject: Metadata must be a JSON object.
skillsRepo.refScheme: Use an https, git+https, oci, or s3 reference.
skillsRepo.emptyDescription: Create an org skill, define who can resolve it, then save inline content or a credential-free artifact reference.
skillsRepo.contentSourceDescription: Store a complete SKILL.md inline or point to an immutable artifact without credentials.
skillsRepo.contentRefHint: Pin a digest or commit where the scheme supports it. Embedded credentials are rejected.
skillsRepo.versionMetadataDescription: Optional non-secret JSON for runtime requirements, capabilities, or provenance.
skillsRepo.secretFieldsRejected: Fields containing secret, password, token, or API key names are rejected by the control plane.
skillsRepo.allowedTeamsHint: No selection shares the skill with every team in the organization.
skillsRepo.retireHint: Callers can no longer resolve it. Versions remain in history.
skillsRepo.createDescription: Define its identity and access policy. Content is saved as a separate immutable version.
skillsRepo.settingsDescription: Change the human-facing metadata and who can resolve this skill. The slug and versions stay immutable.
skillsRepo.rollbackDescription: This changes the resolved version from v{{from}} to immutable v{{to}}. Newer versions remain in history.
